item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\np=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); before=copy.deepcopy((p,rs)); out=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert (p,rs)==before; assert out==json.load(open('report.json')); cases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'ready','to':'running','retry':True,'attempts':0},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'operator_0','retry':True,'attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'draft','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':-1},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'draft','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'})]\\nfor req,pol,want in cases: assert evaluate(req,pol)==want,(req,evaluate(req,pol),want)\\nprint('ok',out)\"]}"}
